## Cavalo do Sonho (CR 12)

This bat-winged horse is nearly hairless, with purple-gray hide that resembles cracked stone. It does sport a lush, flowing mane of black hair, and its tail is a long cascade of gray-black hair. Its eyes and nostrils grow with a livid internal fire, while its flapping wings creak ominously.  

**XP** 19,200  
CE Large outsider (evil)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., scent; Perception +23; Aura evil  


**Defense**


**AC** 28, touch 14, flat-footed 23 (+5 Dex, +24 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 184 (16d10+96)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +15, **Will** +14  
**Immunities** electricity, fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., fly 90 ft. (average)  
**Melee** bite +22 (1d4+7), hooves +22 (1d6+7 plus 2d6 electricity)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (15-ft. cone, DC 23, 9d10 fire plus catching on fire, usable every 1d4 rounds), storm burst (20-ft. burst, DC 23, 10d6 electricity), world walk  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 20, **Con** 20, **Int** 6, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 20  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +24; **CMD** 39  
**Feats** Alertness, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Hover, Improved Initiative, Run, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Wind Stance  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Fly +23, Knowledge (planes) +17, Perception +23, Sense Motive +15, Intimidate +16  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Infernal (cannot speak)  
**SQ** confer fire resistance, dream rider, illumination  


**Special Abilities**



**Breath Weapon (Su)** The cavalo do sonho can exhale a blast of fiery nightmare energy in a 15-foot cone. A creature that fails its saving through catches on fire, taking 1d6 fire damage each round at the beginning of its turn until the flames are extinguished.  

**Confer Fire Resistance (Su)** As a free action, the cavalo do sonho can confer fire resistance 30 to its rider.  

**Dream Rider (Su)** As a swift action, the cavalo do sonho can fade itself (and its rider, if it has one) into a figment of animate dream until the end of its turn, allowing it to move through solid objects and creatures as if it were incorporeal, though it treats solid objects and mindless creatures as difficult terrain. Attacks of opportunity against the cavalo do sonho or its rider while moving in dream-form are resolved as if they were incorporeal. The cavalo do sonho and its rider cannot attack while in this state.  

**Illumination (Su)** As a free action the cavalo do sonho can shed ruddy light like a burning torch or can stop shedding light.  

**Storm Burst (Su)** Once per day, the cavalo do sonho can release a burst of storm energy and fierce winds in a 20-foot-radius spread centered on itself, dealing 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 10d6 points of electricity damage (DC 23 Reflex half) to any creature within or entering the area until the beginning of the cavalo do sonho’s next turn. This area is treated as difficult terrain for all creatures other than the cavalo do sonho or creatures using freedom of movement or that is immune to the effects of strong wind conditions. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**World Walk (Su)** Once per day, the cavalo do sonho can use ethereal jaunt, plane shift, or greater teleport. It can take its rider along with it but no other creatures; a rider’s familiar is treated as part of the rider for this purpose.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
